about_zh: IM、机器人、社交平台与社区协作。

repos.description: 🆓免费的 ChatGPT 镜像网站列表，持续更新。List of free ChatGPT mirror sites, continuously updated.
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库持续维护312个免费ChatGPT镜像站点列表，提供无需登录或低门槛访问GPT-4、Claude等AI模型的途径。收录网站涵盖完全免费、有免费额度等多种类型，并附带替代方案与自建指南，为开发者、研究人员及普通用户提供便捷的AI工具导航服务。
repos.summary_en: This repository maintains a continuously updated list of 312 free ChatGPT mirror sites, offering developers, researchers, and general users easy access to AI models like GPT-4, Claude, and DeepSeek without login or low barriers. It categorizes sites by free tiers, login requirements, and model support, while providing alternatives, self-hosting guides, prompt engineering resources, and developer tools for convenient AI tool discovery and implementation.

repos.description: Windows版本微信客户端（非网页版）自动化，可实现简单的发送、接收微信消息，简单微信机器人
repos.summary_zh: wxauto 提供 Windows 原生微信客户端的 Python 自动化接口，基于 UIAutomation 技术直接操控微信 3.9.X 版本，实现消息收发与简易机器人功能。无需 Web 版限制，支持 Windows 10/11 系统，适用于个人微信消息批量处理与自动化场景。项目已于 2025 年 10 月停止维护，仅限学习交流使用。
repos.summary_en: wxauto is a Python automation library for native Windows WeChat client (v3.9.X) that leverages UIAutomation technology to directly control the desktop application. It enables sending/receiving messages, building simple chatbots, and automating WeChat interactions without web versions. Compatible with Windows 10/11 and Python 3.9+, it serves personal automation needs. Important: Discontinued in October 2025, intended solely for educational and research purposes.

repos.description: Collection great groups, channels, bots and libraries for Telegram
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个精选的Telegram资源聚合仓库，系统整理了官方与社区开发的优质机器人、群组、频道及开发库。涵盖新闻资讯、群组管理、财务记账、语音转译、PDF处理等多元化场景，提供从功能工具到社区运营的完整生态索引，是Telegram用户发现服务和开发者寻找灵感的核心枢纽。
repos.summary_en: A curated repository aggregating premium Telegram resources including bots, groups, channels, and development libraries. Features diverse applications spanning news delivery, community moderation, financial tracking, speech translation, and PDF processing. Provides a comprehensive ecosystem index for both end-users seeking utility services and developers exploring bot development opportunities on the Telegram platform, serving as a central discovery hub.

repos.description: 把 Markdown 一键排成可直接粘进公众号编辑器的精致 HTML —— 6 套精选主题 + 主题生成器 + 双关卡校验。An AI-agent skill that turns Markdown into paste-ready WeChat article HTML.
repos.summary_zh: gzh-design-skill 是一个专为 AI Agent 设计的公众号排版技能，将 Markdown 一键转为微信编辑器兼容的内联 HTML。内置 6 套精选主题及主题生成器，支持自动章节编号、关键词下划线、代码块图片 GIF 处理，并通过 Python 双重校验脚本确保质量。适用于教程测评、深度分析、数据报告等场景，规避平台格式限制，实现确定性高质量输出，提升内容创作效率。
repos.summary_en: gzh-design-skill is an AI-agent skill that converts Markdown into paste-ready, inline-styled HTML optimized for the WeChat public account editor. It features 6 curated themes, a theme generator, automatic chapter numbering, keyword highlighting, code block/image/GIF support, and dual Python validation scripts. Ideal for tutorials, reviews, analyses, and reports, it ensures WeChat compatibility and deterministic quality for agents like Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor.

repos.description: 使用Telegram作为存储的文件外链系统，不限制文件大小和格式。
repos.summary_zh: tgState 是一款创新的文件外链系统，深度利用 Telegram 的 Bot API 和 FileID 机制，将 Telegram 频道/群组作为无限容量存储后端。系统支持任意大小格式的文件存储分发，提供 Web 界面和 API 上传接口，可作为图床或私有网盘使用。支持 Docker、Vercel 等多种部署方式，配合 CloudFlare 可实现高效 CDN 加速。
repos.summary_en: tgState is an innovative file hosting system that leverages Telegram's Bot API and FileID mechanism to utilize Telegram channels/groups as unlimited-capacity storage backend. Supporting files of any size and format, it provides both web interface and API for uploads, functioning as image hosting or private cloud storage. Features flexible deployment via Docker, Vercel, or binary, with CloudFlare CDN integration for optimized content delivery.

repos.description: 【零费用】一个让人呼吸顺畅的 Telegram 双向私聊机器人 🤖 / [Zero Cost] A Smooth-Operating Two-Way Private Messaging Telegram Bot 🤖
repos.summary_zh: Open Wegram Bot 是基于 Cloudflare Worker/Vercel 的 Telegram 双向私聊机器人，实现零成本、无服务器、无数据库的消息中转。采用无状态架构，支持 GitHub/Vercel 等多平台一键部署，无需绑定域名即可运行。适用于个人消息代理、轻量级客服等场景，提供稳定可靠的双向通信能力，是 LivegramBot 的免费替代方案。
repos.summary_en: Open Wegram Bot is a Telegram two-way private messaging bot built on Cloudflare Worker/Vercel, enabling zero-cost, serverless, database-free message forwarding. Featuring stateless architecture, it supports one-click deployment via GitHub/Vercel/Deno/Netlify without custom domain binding. Designed for personal message proxy and lightweight customer service, it provides stable bidirectional communication as a free alternative to LivegramBot with multi-bot support and encrypted security tokens for reliable operation.
